overview.name: Matthew Florek
overview.headline: Data analytics, business intelligence, and AI-assisted workflows
overview.shortBio: I build practical systems that turn messy information and repetitive work into clearer decisions and more reliable workflows. My work sits at the intersection of data analysis, automation, operations, and AI-assisted software development.
overview.longBio: My background combines finance, business analytics, data quality, workflow automation, and hands-on systems building. I enjoy taking an ambiguous operational problem, finding the structure inside it, and turning that structure into a tool, dataset, dashboard, or repeatable process that people can actually use.
